release.qa_classification: NOT a regression from this contract and NOT a backend defect. Classified as environment drift caused by the founder's OTP_MOCK=false flip on Render. Proof: qa targets production (QA_API_BASE default https://inflx-platform.onrender.com/v1) and this contract's code was unpushed at run time (git log origin/main..HEAD empty), so the suite could not have exercised it. Both tests hardcode otp:'000000', which only ever verified while OTP_MOCK=true; W5a/W5b assert role validation that sits AFTER otpService.verifyOtp() in auth.controller.js, so a real code makes the assertion unreachable. Released RED-with-classification rather than skipping, weakening or fabricating a green (no-fake-green).
release.qa_followup: Two tests are structurally unreachable against a live-OTP production and will stay red until either (a) the qa lane is pointed at a backend with OTP_MOCK=true, or (b) the role check is moved ahead of verifyOtp() in auth.controller.js — which independently fixes a real bug where an invalid/missing role consumes the user's OTP and forces a re-request. Option (b) carries a mild user-enumeration tradeoff. Founder decision pending; to be carved as its own contract.
